# zstd / sequence_compression_api

zstd's own fuzz target `sequence_compression_api` ([source](source/sequence_compression_api.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over zstd (facebook/zstd at 82d322c4).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: Random valid sequence list (offsets within the window, optional 1 GiB raw dictionary, explicit or no block delimiters) -> the harness's own decodeSequences builds the source -> ZSTD_compressSequences with validateSequences=1 -> ZSTD_decompressDCtx: must succeed, regenerate the size and match byte for byte.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zstd at commit 82d322c4.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- Random valid sequence list (offsets within the window, optional 1 GiB raw dictionary, explicit or no block delimiters) -> the harness's own decodeSequences builds the source -> ZSTD_compressSequences with validateSequences=1 -> ZSTD_decompressDCtx: must succeed, regenerate the size and match byte for byte ([lines 316-333](source/sequence_compression_api.c#L316-L333)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.
- ZSTD_compressSequences must accept every generated sequence list; only dstSize_tooSmall in explicit-block-delimiter mode is excused ([lines 319-328](source/sequence_compression_api.c#L319-L328)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

A failure of the check at lines 316-333 ends the process with a status that the halts statements below that name it exclude, so a proof of one of those statements implies it on every input it covers. No statement here proves the other check.
